title: Equipment inspection protocol
body: Inspect the cooling assembly every 200 operating hours. Record the inspection in the maintenance register. If vibration exceeds 4.5 mm/s, stop the equipment and notify the shift supervisor.

title: Incident escalation procedure
body: A severity-one incident must be reported to the duty manager within 15 minutes. Isolate the affected workstation and preserve the local execution logs. Resume operation only after written approval from the duty manager.

title: Supplier payment controls
body: Supplier payments above INR 100,000 require approval from both the finance controller and the procurement lead. The requester cannot approve their own payment. All approvals must be recorded before release.

title: Offline update policy
body: Transfer update bundles using approved removable media. Verify the manifest and checksum before installation. A designated administrator must approve each update. Keep the previous approved version available for rollback.
